baseline: Heat stress is measured against the Maximum Monthly Mean (MMM): the average temperature of the hottest month, from 1985-2012 satellite data. Bleaching threshold = MMM + 1 degC. Degree Heating Weeks (DHW, degC-weeks) add up every day's HotSpot (temperature above MMM) that is at least 1 degC, over the last 12 weeks. About 4 DHW: significant bleaching likely; 8 DHW or more: widespread bleaching and some mortality likely (NOAA Coral Reef Watch). Each reef entry is a NOAA 5 km Regional Virtual Station (a whole GBR region), not a single reef: its DHW is computed from the 90th-percentile HotSpot of the pixels in the region polygon, so it describes the hot end of the region.
summerLabelNote: A summer is labelled by the year it ends: '2024' = November 2023 to June 2024. dhw[] covers 1 Nov to 30 Jun for the summers 2016, 2017, 2020, 2022, 2024 and 2025; peaks are given for 2016 to 2026. sst_c is the CRW 'SST at 90th-percentile HotSpot' (degC).

2024.label: High to extreme bleaching (more than 30% of coral cover bleached)
2024.basis: region-level: share of surveyed reefs in each group, as published (rounded; sums to 99)
2024.note: Southern region reefs south of the Whitsundays. 80% of surveyed reefs showed high (31-60%) to extreme (>90%) bleaching; only 3% had none. AIMS reef-level heat stress at surveyed reefs: 6.22-15.55 DHW (highest on the NOAA satellite record 1985-2024).

2024.label: High to extreme bleaching on most reefs, but more variable than the south
2024.basis: region-level: share of aerial-survey reefs in each group (AIMS LTMP 2023/24 report)
2024.note: Central region, Cooktown to the Whitsundays. 76.1% of aerial-survey reefs had high/very high/extreme bleaching. Bleaching was typically highest on inshore reefs and lower on outer-shelf reefs. AIMS reef-level heat stress: 2.39-11.41 DHW.

2024.label: No bleaching (most common score)
2024.basis: region-level: counts of the 186 Torres Strait reefs that received a score (AIMS 2024 report, Table 1); category = most common score
2024.note: 94% of surveyed Torres Strait reefs had no to low bleaching (scores 0-1). 58 further reefs could not be scored. AIMS reef-level heat stress at surveyed reefs: 0.97-8.94 DHW.

surveyScaleNote: AIMS/GBRMPA 2024 aerial surveys use six categories, 0 to 5. (The 2016 and 2017 surveys by Hughes et al. merged categories 4 and 5 into one '4 = more than 60%', giving 0-4.)
